description: A complete beginner’s golf kit at today’s lowest UK prices, checked every 6 hours across multiple UK retailers: a package set with a bag, golf shoes (in stock in men’s sizes 8 to 10), a dozen balls, a glove and tees, with each item’s price and link and the total. Two levels: "trying" (the cheapest sensible kit) and "hooked" (a full 13/14-piece set and better balls). Also says what the kit cost about a month ago. Use for questions like "how much does it cost to start golf?" or "what golf kit does a beginner need?".
name: start_golf_kit
title: What it costs to start golf in the UK
